```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json

import pandas as pd
import polars as pl

PROJECT_ROOT = Path("/Users/vicenteonetto/Desktop/FCFM/MDS/Tesis_Local/tesis-project")
SEG_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "audits" / "user_level_redesign" / "segmentation"

SCOPE = "interannual_ml"
VARIANT = "clean"
HOME_FILTER = "alta"
MIN_TRIPS = 3
MIN_HOME_TRIPS = 0
MATRIX_SPEC = "macro_franja_modo"
NORMALIZATION = "share"

def universe_suffix(scope, variant, home_filter, min_trips, min_home_trips=0):
    suffix = f"{scope}_{variant}_{home_filter}_n{min_trips}"
    if min_home_trips > 0:
        suffix += f"_home{min_home_trips}"
    return suffix

MATRIX_STEM = (
    f"user_mobility_matrix_"
    f"{universe_suffix(SCOPE, VARIANT, HOME_FILTER, MIN_TRIPS, MIN_HOME_TRIPS)}_"
    f"{MATRIX_SPEC}_{NORMALIZATION}"
)
MATRIX_PATH = SEG_DIR / f"{MATRIX_STEM}.parquet"
INVENTORY_PATH = SEG_DIR / f"{MATRIX_STEM}_feature_inventory.json"
NMF_DIR = SEG_DIR / "nmf" / MATRIX_STEM
POSTHOC_DIR = NMF_DIR / "posthoc"

print("label: setup")
print(f"matrix_path: {MATRIX_PATH} exists={MATRIX_PATH.exists()}")
print(f"inventory_path: {INVENTORY_PATH} exists={INVENTORY_PATH.exists()}")
print(f"nmf_dir: {NMF_DIR} exists={NMF_DIR.exists()}")
```

## Commands

```{python}
#| label: commands
PY = "/Users/vicenteonetto/.local/share/mamba/envs/larch-env/bin/python"

build_cmd = f"""{PY} \\
  scripts/audits/build_user_mobility_segmentation_matrix.py \\
  --scope {SCOPE} --variant {VARIANT} --home-filter {HOME_FILTER} --min-trips {MIN_TRIPS} \\
  --matrix-spec {MATRIX_SPEC} --normalization {NORMALIZATION} --force"""

nmf_cmd = f"""{PY} \\
  scripts/audits/run_user_nmf_segmentation.py \\
  --scope {SCOPE} --variant {VARIANT} --home-filter {HOME_FILTER} --min-trips {MIN_TRIPS} \\
  --matrix-spec {MATRIX_SPEC} --normalization {NORMALIZATION} \\
  --k-range 2-8 --n-runs 10 --seed 20260527"""

posthoc_cmd = f"""{PY} \\
  scripts/audits/summarize_user_nmf_segments.py \\
  --scope {SCOPE} --variant {VARIANT} --home-filter {HOME_FILTER} --min-trips {MIN_TRIPS} \\
  --matrix-spec {MATRIX_SPEC} --normalization {NORMALIZATION} --k all"""

print("label: commands")
print("\n# 1) Build matrix\n" + build_cmd)
print("\n# 2) Run NMF\n" + nmf_cmd)
print("\n# 3) Post-hoc summary\n" + posthoc_cmd)
```

## Matrix Audit

```{python}
#| label: matrix-audit
print("label: matrix-audit")
summary_path = SEG_DIR / f"{MATRIX_STEM}_summary.csv"
feature_dist_path = SEG_DIR / f"{MATRIX_STEM}_feature_distribution.csv"

if INVENTORY_PATH.exists():
    inventory = json.loads(INVENTORY_PATH.read_text())
    print({
        "n_features": len(inventory.get("feature_cols", [])),
        "matrix_spec": inventory.get("matrix_spec"),
        "normalization": inventory.get("normalization"),
        "target_metadata_cols": inventory.get("target_metadata_cols"),
    })
else:
    print(f"Missing inventory: {INVENTORY_PATH}")

if summary_path.exists():
    display(pl.read_csv(summary_path).to_pandas())
else:
    print(f"Missing summary: {summary_path}")

if feature_dist_path.exists():
    feature_dist = pl.read_csv(feature_dist_path).sort("sum", descending=True)
    display(feature_dist.head(25).to_pandas())
else:
    print(f"Missing feature distribution: {feature_dist_path}")
```

## NMF Diagnostics

```{python}
#| label: nmf-diagnostics
print("label: nmf-diagnostics")
metrics_path = NMF_DIR / "nmf_metrics.csv"
top_features_path = NMF_DIR / "nmf_top_features.csv"
meta_path = NMF_DIR / "run_meta.json"

if meta_path.exists():
    meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text())
    print({
        "k_range": meta.get("k_range"),
        "fit_sample_n": meta.get("fit_sample_n"),
        "elbow": meta.get("elbow"),
        "save_scores": meta.get("save_scores"),
    })
else:
    print(f"Missing NMF meta: {meta_path}")

if metrics_path.exists():
    metrics = pl.read_csv(metrics_path)
    display(metrics.to_pandas())
else:
    print(f"Missing NMF metrics: {metrics_path}")

if top_features_path.exists():
    top_features = pl.read_csv(top_features_path)
    display(top_features.filter(pl.col("rank") <= 8).to_pandas())
else:
    print(f"Missing NMF top features: {top_features_path}")
```
